params._royaltyReceiver: Address that receives royalty share on finalization

bid(uint256).notice: Place a bid on an active auction.         Must meet minimum bid (startPrice or 5% above current highest bid).         Extends auction by 10 minutes if bid arrives in last 10 minutes.

cancelAuction(uint256).notice: Cancel an auction that has NO bids. Only the seller can cancel.         Returns the escrowed NFT to the seller.

createAuction(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Create an auction for a MYTHIC NFT. NFT is escrowed in this contract.         Token must have firstListed == true. Duration: 1 hour – 7 days.

finalizeAuction(uint256).notice: Finalize an auction after it ends.         If there's a winner: pays royalty, pays seller, transfers NFT.         If no bids: returns NFT to seller.

pendingReturns(address,uint256).notice: Pending ETH returns for outbid participants, per auction

withdrawPendingReturn(uint256).notice: Withdraw pending ETH return from an outbid position.         Uses checks-effects-interactions pattern to prevent reentrancy.
